b.x: The shop window and the craft

The law of attraction, on stage, is a shop-window note: think of the car, cut the photo, the universe delivers. In the gray craft it is another sentence, shorter: what you feel, think, and hold with intensity begins to organize around you. Fear calls fear. Gratitude opens. It is not shop magic. It is the station you tune — field 96 — and what the hand does after — field 95.
DO
Field question: am I attracting a state — or a shop-window object? The state fits Tuesday. The object, without the hand, is theatre.
Three parts. The shop window skips the third

1. The tone. The body has already chosen a frequency before the sentence. Fear, guilt, pride, gratitude, peace. Fields 23 and 94. With no tone, the law of attraction is only a note. With the tone in fear, it works — against you.

2. Attention. What you hold all day becomes proof. End-times headline, collapse group, Apocalypse rehearsal on the bus: the eye trains threat and the street delivers threat. Fields 19 and 96. Attention is a magnet. It always was.

3. The hand. Here the shop window vanishes. Water in the pantry. A short sentence. Point B on paper. One step of tone and then a gesture Tuesday already eats. Without the hand, gratitude is a stage. With the hand and the tone in fear, the gesture still narrows. The three together: that is co-creating.
The Tuesday test

If the law of attraction does not survive the bus, it is still costume. What fits: one minute of high tone in the body; refusing the end-times film; a small gesture (water, torch, a short no). What does not: a wish-board in place of the pantry; blaming whoever suffered the flood for ‘having attracted it’; asking the universe for what the hand refuses to do.
NOTE
Co-creating does not cancel the street. The street turns. The bill is late. Gray reads the fact and chooses the station from which he answers. The fact does not vanish because you raised the tone.
What this field refuses
It does not teach a vision board, ‘ask and you shall receive’, a car in a photo in place of water.
It does not teach that the victim attracted the flood, the stroke, the scam. That is stage cruelty.
It does not teach denying real danger. Twelve seconds, emergency numbers, the clinic: they still stand.
It does not replace a doctor, emergency care. Panic: the clinic, not the wish-board.

It teaches only this: tone + attention + hand. The shop window sells the object. Gray chooses the station and makes the gesture. Field 96 is the magnet. Field 95 is the rehearsal. This field joins the three.
